spec_features.evidence: Loop bounded by for i in range(cfg.max_turns) (agent.py:114); on natural exhaustion the for-else sets tr.stop_reason = tr.stop_reason or 'turn_cap' (agent.py:165-166). Default 8 (agent.py:78, runner.py:32, default.yaml:15). Cap is checked and terminates execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 8             # turn cap per rollout. Tune for cost vs. spiral room.

spec_features.feature_name: Early-stop on N identical consecutive actions
spec_features.spec_quote: abort a rollout once N identical consecutive actions occur
spec_features.evidence: repeat_run incremented when fingerprint==last_fp (agent.py:130-131); enforced: if cfg.early_stop and repeat_run >= cfg.early_stop_repeat: tr.stop_reason='early_stop'; break (agent.py:154-156). early_stop=True / early_stop_repeat=4 wired (agent.py:81-82, runner.py:35-36, default.yaml:18-19).
spec_features.notes: Fingerprint = sha256 of (name,args); only consecutive identical actions trigger it, matching the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early_stop: true         # stop a rollout once it's clearly looping (saves tokens)
